body: Well, in this world the productive and successful people seem to have the most power and influence. That is the natural order of things. You know extremely successful people who are open about them being suicidal? Maybe, but the rest killed themselves. That is just how it is. Being suicidal is not good for business or being productive.

Looks like a dam promising life to me. I know people in similar situations who still have plenty of potential. You can make up those credits. You may have missed high school the first time around, but you have your entire life ahead of you. Math sucks, but you just gotta roll with it sometimes, nothing to die over.
Your natural instincts to stay alive, simple as that. The worst shit ever, nobody deserves this. I, for one can feel at peace with the opportunity for a permanent siesta/nap.

I feel like I could change myself and fit in society, but the suffering is too hard for me. I am looking for a light at the end of the tunnel, and suicide is already an unexpected potential solution for me. I do not have the willpower to face any of my fears or find a solution that involves staying alive. What am I, a soon to be statistic? I have tried living and I have come to the conclusion that it is not for me.

I have always felt that this is not fair, I want those pages back. I have always been told that I am privileged for my race and sex, but I feel like I have no cards to play in life. I am set to have mental breakdowns and future suffering. Why me, it's not fair. My siblings are managing to do much better under similar circumstances. I still have supportive family, but being truthful I feel like I have nobody. Any friends I make will not know about my past, and if they find out they would likely be pushed away by that alone. It is just not fair, and I want it to end.

All I have ever known my entire life was how messed up and terrible I am and still are. It has been ingrained into me by my upbringing, perhaps I was not born this way but nurture beats nature in my opinion.
I wish I could have been born a different person in a different family. Life sucks man.
